title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 162
paragraphs: To this Gelon replied: “Athenian stranger, it seems you have the commanders, but no men to be commanded. Since, then, you will not yield at all and want the whole, you had best go home as fast as you can and tell the Greeks that the spring has been taken out of their year.” The meaning of the saying is this: that the spring is plainly the noblest part of the year, and so he meant to say that his army was the noblest part of the Greek army; thus Greece, deprived of his alliance, was, he said, as if the spring had been taken out of the year.
